pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, Margate, 7...Bd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...b5 with White's bishop on b5; the overview spoke loosely of two pins. Rewrote the overview and plan 2; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7.Qd2 Be7 8.O-O-O Nxd4
pages.notes: Plan 3 said White gains the bishop pair after Bxf6 gxf6, when it is Black who keeps both bishops; plans 3 and 4 named ...gxf6 before White can take on f6. Rewrote plans 3 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7.Qd2 Be7 8.O-O-O Nxd4
pages.notes: Plan 4 had White play Kh1 with the king on c1. Rewrote plan 4 around f4, e5, Kb1 and Bc4 or Be2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7.Qd2 Be7, 9.Nb3 a5
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an Ng3-h5 route with no knight able to reach g3. Rewrote plan 1 around f3, g4 and h4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7.Qd2 Be7, 9.Nb3 a6
pages.notes: Plan 4 called the g5-bishop light-squared and had Black play ...Bxf3 with no knight on f3; plan 2 called a pawn storm a minority attack. Rewrote plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7.Qd2 Qb6 8.Nb3
pages.notes: Plan 2 used a ...b5-b4 route from an empty b5. Reworded plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7.Qd2 Qb6 8.Nb3 a6
pages.notes: Plan 2 used a ...b5-b4 route from an empty b5. Reworded plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7.Qd2 Qb6 8.Nb3 a6 9.O-O-O
pages.notes: Plan 4 had Black exchange the dark-squared bishop for a knight on f3 that does not exist; plan 3 spoke of pins with no piece behind f6. Rewrote plans 3 and 4 and reworded plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7.Qd2 Qb6 8.Nb3 a6 9.O-O-O Be7
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...Rxc3 with no rook able to reach c3 yet; plan 1 called f5 an outpost. Reworded plans 1, 2 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7.Qd2 Be7, 9.f4 h6
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...g5 with the bishop still on g5 and missed the main ...e5 idea after Bh4. Rewrote plan 4.
